state.subject: Disposition plan for 19 blocked kanban cards.
state.evidence: Each card dispositioned with direct DB evidence and file checks. 2 cards had no artifact on disk.
state.policy: Plans touching card outcomes need review proportional to how much of the plan rests on unverified claims.

review_need.instructions: Rate how much human review this plan needs, from the evidence. Do not infer unobserved impact.
criteria: No review needed; every claim is backed by observed evidence.
Light review; claims are consistent but a few need a second look.
Full review; material claims rest on inference rather than observation.
Blocking review; the evidence contradicts the plan or is missing.
